build_GuidedAnchorHead: build a GuidedAnchorHead instance with num_classes, in_channels, and configurable anchor generators for object detection
create_FeatureAdaption: create a FeatureAdaption module using DeformConv2d to adapt features based on anchor shape predictions
run_forward_single: run forward_single on a single scale level feature map to get cls_score, bbox_pred, shape_pred, and loc_pred
test_loss_by_feat: test the loss_by_feat method to calculate classification, bbox, shape, and location losses for training
predict_predict_by_feat: predict bounding boxes by transforming head features into detection results with NMS post-processing
